reasoning_traces.think:
The PlusDC-BT module encodes team strength via Bradley-Terry probabilities, using logistic regression over game outcomes and covariates. It enforces normalization constraints on utilities and applies ridge regularization to ensure stable estimates even with weak connectivity. The model supports player-aware updates through QB shifts, enabling adaptive ratings without full retraining. Acceptance gates require superior performance over Elo and BT on log-loss while maintaining sign consistency of covariates. Early-season fallback uses RankCentrality to avoid overfitting during sparse data periods. EnbPI provides calibrated uncertainty bounds around point forecasts, leveraging bootstrap samples to construct valid prediction intervals. Its breakdown regime hinges on data sparsity and model exchangeability. The Kelly optimizer integrates edge-based stakes with redundancy screening and stop-loss scaling, ensuring long-term capital preservation. It rejects strategies that fail to meet minimum log-growth thresholds or exceed stop-hit frequencies. These primitives form a coherent architecture where each layer validates and refines the next, enforcing mathematical rigor through ledger-gated criteria.
